description:
Location: Dallas, TX (Hybrid Role)

 
 To qualify, applicants must be a U.S. Citizen 
 
 
 About One Network Enterprises, Inc. (ONE), a Blue Yonder Company​: 
 One Network Enterprises, Inc. (ONE), a Blue Yonder Company, is the pioneer in multi-party supply chain network technology, and is changing the way the world’s Defense Organizations make business decisions and provide critical logistics capabilities to the warfighter. To realize our potential, we need highly intelligent, collaborative people who are committed to solving challenging problems in a dynamic environment. Do you love exciting opportunities where you can make a big difference? One Network offers you the chance to fuel our rapid growth and make a true impact while working with the latest advancements in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Supply Chain Planning technologies. ( https://www.onenetwork.com/ )
 
 Summary: 
 One Network Enterprises, Inc. (ONE), a Blue Yonder Company is seeking a Software Engineering I to join our dynamic team in Dallas, TX. Core responsibilities to include analyze business requirements and designs for accuracy and completeness. Develops and maintains relevant product. Join us in our mission to reshape supply chain management with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions. Your skills and passion can make a significant impact!
 
 What you'll do: 
 Understands and analyze business requirements and assists in design for accuracy and completeness.

 Develops and maintains relevant product.

 Build/maintain existing react based applications with best-in-class user experience.

 Demonstrates good understanding of the product and owns one or more modules

 
 What we're looking for: 
 Bachelor’s Degree with 1 to 2 years of experience in Software

 Development of large and complex enterprise applications.

 Experience in developing enterprise application using ReactJS, React Native, Node JS and Express JS framework.

 Knowledge on latest features like ES6, React Hooks, Styled-Components, Service-Worker.

 Hands on experience in unit testing frameworks like Mocha or Jest is a must.

 Expertise in building Cloud apps, Web apps with Multi-Lingual support.

 Experience in working with version control tools like GIT Hub or Stash is a must.

 Experience in Responsive Web Design (RWD) for Web Applications.

 Experience in working with BFF approach of development.

 Identifies & builds reusable components.

 Knowledge on Java, Rest APIs is an added advantage.

 Knowledge on SQL and NoSQL databases.

 Knowledge in building apps with Docker and using cloud platforms like Azure or AWS is added advantage.

 Develops and maintains relevant product and domain knowledge

 Ensures that the code is delivered for Integration Build and Test which includes the release content

 Developer with DevOps mindset who has experience in working with Operations teams and identifying bugs and solve them.

 Adheres to the performance benchmark based on pre-defined requirements

 Possesses knowledge of database architecture and data models used in the relevant product.

 Proactively reports all activities to the reporting managers and seeks assistance as required from peers.

 Demonstrates problem solving and innovation ability.

 
 Our current technical environment: 
 Software: Data Structures & Algorithms, Java, Spring boot, Gradle, GIT, Hibernate, Rest API, OAuth, React

 Application Architecture: Scalable, Resilient, event driven, secure multi-tenant Microservices architecture

 Cloud Architecture: MS Azure (ARM templates, AKS, HD insight, Application gateway, Virtue Networks, Event Hub, Azure AD)

 Frameworks/Others: Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Spark, NOSQL, RDBMS, Spring boot, Gradle GIT, Ignite

 Software Development: TDD & Agile (SCRUM)

 
 Why Blue Yonder? 
 At Blue Yonder, you'll be part of a diverse and innovative team working on cutting-edge technologies that are shaping the future of supply chain management. As an intern, you'll have the opportunity to learn from industry experts, contribute to meaningful projects, and gain hands-on experience in automation and cloud deployment. Join us in our mission to revolutionize the world of supply chain solutions.









 ------------------------------------------- 
 The salary range for this position is USD $ 75,000 - $85,000
 
 The salary range information provided, reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data.  Minimums and maximums may vary based on location.  Individual salary will be commensurate with skills, experience, certifications or licenses and other relevant factors.  In addition, this role will be eligible to participate in either the annual performance bonus or commission program, determined by the nature of the position.
 
 At Blue Yonder, we care about the wellbeing of our employees and those most important to them. This is reflected in our robust benefits package and options that includes: 
 Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision 

 401K with Matching 

 Flexible Time Off 

 Corporate Fitness Program 

 A variety of voluntary benefits such as; Legal Plans, Accident and Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and much more

 
 At Blue Yonder, we are committed to a workplace that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging in which everyone can share their unique voices and talents in a safe space. We continue to be guided by our core values and are proud of our diverse culture as an equal opportunity employer. We understand that your career search may look different than others, and embrace the professional, personal, educational, and volunteer opportunities through which people gain experience.
 
 
 Our Values 
 
If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values 
 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
